verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a desktop coding-agent app whose agent runs git operations (branches, commits, pull-request reviews) on the user's own code projects. That is a feature for managing code, not a documented way to version, review, or roll back the user's automations. Nothing in the pack shows automations being versioned, diffed, reviewed, or reverted inside the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
